name: DOVA-SYNDROME
desc: Japanese free BGM and SFX library for games and video.
usage: Search by mood, then check each track's license.

name: Maou Damashii
desc: Large free music library that is commonly usable commercially.
usage: Download and credit as the page asks.
license: Usually CC BY; check the page.

name: Amacha Music Studio
desc: Soft Japanese free BGM for towns and visual-novel scenes.
usage: Pick a mood pack and keep the credit line.

name: Pocket Sound
desc: Japanese free sound effects for UI and everyday actions.
usage: Browse by category and download shorts.

name: Mixkit Music
desc: Free music and SFX with a clear license page.
usage: Start with Free Stock Music, then SFX.
license: Free for commercial use; keep attribution notes.

name: Incompetech
desc: Kevin MacLeod royalty-free music, a long-standing source.
usage: Filter by genre and credit as requested.

name: BeepBox
usage: Compose, then export WAV or share the link.
license: Tool is free; you own the music.

name: Bosca Ceoil
desc: Tiny composer that is good for game loops.
usage: Write a short loop and export it into the engine.

name: BBC Sound Effects
desc: Large archive of remixeable ambience and field recordings.
usage: Search by environment and read the reuse terms.
license: BBC reuse terms; check commercial use.

name: Zapsplat
desc: Large game-oriented SFX library after signup.
usage: Use a free account and watch the daily quota.
license: Account required; free and paid licenses.
